description:
As member of Black Torch at the Bureau of Espionage, Ichika is the only daughter of the renowned and respected Kishimojin family of spies and has from a young age persevered through years of demanding training. Her exceptional work ethic is the driving force behind her quest to reach the apex of achievement in espionage and to face responsibility head-on. Aside from her palpably strong dislike for mononoke, her demeanor toward Jirou and his comrade Ragou is equally severe. Ichika`s sense of justice and responsibility, with equal parts determination and seriousness, are second to none.
Source: Official page
name: Kishimojin Ichika
